### Description and Rationale
I'm Parth Patil, a 3rd-year B.Tech IT student at Vishwakarma Institute of Technology (VIT Pune), India, working on AI/ML and full-stack projects including a patent-pending AI elderly-care system and a property-intelligence platform. I'm registering solo to get hands-on with a real-world regression problem on operational aviation data — predicting taxi-out times is a great test of feature engineering and time-series thinking beyond typical coursework datasets. I'm using this challenge to build a rigorous, published project (code + open-access paper) that strengthens my applied ML portfolio ahead of research and international opportunities.
